description: Pre-prediction domain-support assessment. Used to inform abstention/confidence. NEVER uses target errors of the new sample. Computed on the depth-to-water modeling population (GT A/B, Phase 0 firewall intact).

classes.IN_DISTRIBUTION: >= 30 training records in the same domain
classes.WEAK_SUPPORT: 1-29 training records in the same domain
classes.OUT_OF_DISTRIBUTION: 0 training records in the domain, or tiny total population

Migjorn.note: Support computed from training-domain feature counts only (no target outcomes of the new sample).

important_distinction: Domain feature support and generalization failure are different concepts. Región de los arenales is well represented by feature counts (IN_DISTRIBUTION support) yet is a documented KNOWN_OOD_DOMAIN because its depth-to-water distribution is fundamentally different (median ~7.8 m vs ~36-48 m in other domains), so the baseline fails there despite ample support. Both flags are retained: support informs confidence/abstention; the known-OOD flag documents the validated generalization failure.
